notes: I inspected all 10 images as pixels, plus the accessibility snapshots, AccountButton.tsx, DesktopShell.tsx, WorkspaceContextBar.tsx and SidebarNavigation.tsx. Across screens the shell is consistent. Product name sits top-left in the sidebar and organisation name in the header (D3). Language and theme sit at the header's right (D7). The active item uses a tinted, bordered row in both modes. Drawer rows are about 52 CSS px. Thai renders without clipped tone marks in nav labels, section labels and the warehouse selector. axe is clean on every capture. Cross-screen issue: the account footer is a working button on finished-goods (expanded, rail and drawer) but plain text with no avatar on the HR desktop page; I filed this under shell-page. Intentional differences, not findings: on HR routes the warehouse selector and the header warehouse line are hidden (DesktopShell.tsx:240-242), so the sidebar search moves up a row. On desktop with the sidebar expanded, the header warehouse line repeats the selector (WorkspaceContextBar.tsx:55-60, a deliberate 'every shell mode' choice). The search dialog itself (empty, typed, AI row, no-results) is not in this image group, so I made no search-dialog findings here. The runtime QA (runtime-qa.json) passes the close/Back/focus-return and Escape-clears-then-closes cases at 390 and 1440. The HR phone capture shows a faint grey fill on the menu button, which looks like a hover or focus-return residue; I did not score it.

I inspected all 10 images as pixels and checked the source and the a11y snapshot for locale-switch__th-mobile-light. The 'th'/'en' in the locale-switch file names is the starting locale: images #1/#2 show /en/ after switching from Thai, and images #3/#4 show /th/ after switching from English. The page, query and theme survive the switch in all four, and the header button names the target language in its own script ('ไทย' / 'English'), with the accessible name 'Switch language to …'. I saw no clipped Thai tone marks or vowels in the shell: sidebar labels, the 'ค้นหาเมนูหรือพนักงาน…' trigger, the dialog title, the 'ไปที่' and 'ให้ AI พาไป' headings, the AI disclosure (D16) and the examples 'ลืมลงเวลาเมื่อวาน' / 'ตั้งวันหยุด' all render with full ascenders and descenders. The empty search follows D14/D16: AI is a labelled examples group with the approved disclosure, the first row is pre-selected with a visible inset accent, the keyboard hint shows only on desktop, and phone rows are about 48 px. Cross-screen: the header's warehouse line repeats the sidebar warehouse selector on desktop (images #2/#4, both 'LOCAL-DEMO · คลังทดสอบ Local…'). This is documented as intentional in WorkspaceContextBar.tsx:58-63, so I did not file it. The Thai search placeholder says 'เมนู' (menu) while the English says 'pages', a minor parity difference I did not file. Typed results, match highlighting, no-match fallback and AI pending/answer states are not in this image group; I did not score them. runtime-qa.json confirms Escape clears then closes, focus returns on close, and native Back dismisses Search at both widths.

I inspected all ten images as pixels, plus the aria snapshots for search-results__th-mobile-light, search-results--mixed__en-desktop-dark and search-no-match__th-mobile-light. Pillow is not installed, so I could not sample pixel contrast. Contrast judgements rely on visual inspection and the reported clean axe runs. Thai renders without clipped tone marks or vowels in the input, highlighted names ('สมชาย'), match-reason lines ('ตรงกับ “employees”') or the three-line AI disclosure. Thai wraps fall at word boundaries ('และ | พนักงาน', 'เพื่อหา | หน้าที่เกี่ยวข้อง'). Both screens follow D14/D16: the AI row comes after typed results (results) or first and preselected (no-match), and it carries the scope and disclosure sentence. The keyboard hint changes to 'Enter ถาม AI / Enter to ask AI' when nothing matches, which is a good touch. Phone rows are about 48–55 CSS px tall. A cross-screen observation, below P3 and so filed only here: most mobile and desktop aria snapshots show 'main > navigation การแบ่งหน้า > status หน้า 1' outside the modal dialog. The page's pagination live region stays exposed while Search is open, probably because the modal's hide-others step leaves live regions visible. search-results--mixed__en-desktop-dark.aria.yml does not show it. Consider marking the background pagination status inert while the dialog is open. Terminology: the nav label 'สแกนใบ Job' (messages/th.json:79) differs from 'ใบงาน' used in FG error strings (messages/th.json:306). The Search screens use the nav label consistently, so I did not score it here.

Per D9, coverage findings record missing evidence and are not meant to count toward the screen caps; the dimension scores above already exclude them. All 12 images were inspected as pixels. The tool returned the shell-loading images in a different display order than listed; each was identified by its size and theme (780×1688 phone vs 1440×900 desktop, light vs dark). Cross-screen: the search entry point is named three ways (“ค้นหาเมนู”, “ค้นหาด้วย AI”, “ค้นหาหน้า ส่วนงาน และรายการ”); filed on search-ai-running and, for the sidebar wording, on shell-loading. Light/dark parity nit (P3, not filed separately): the AI pending row uses a blue tint (#eff6ff) in light but a neutral grey (accent token oklch 0.32) in dark, and the header theme icon is grey in light but lavender in dark. Contrast checked from tokens: dark muted text oklch(0.72) on the pending row oklch(0.32) is about 5:1; light #475569 on #eff6ff passes. Spinner respects reduced motion (spinner.tsx:12). Mobile primary actions measured at about 48 CSS px (Cancel, Reload page, Go to start page). Thai tone marks and vowels are not clipped in any captured button, banner, input or heading.

I inspected all six images as pixels and read two a11y snapshots, th-mobile-light and en-desktop-dark retrying (the other four a11y files were not opened), plus PageFailure.tsx, (desktop)/error.tsx, FailureReference.tsx, Notice.tsx, ButtonControl.tsx and buttonVariants.ts. Captures meet the cross-cutting error anchor: the alert says what failed and that it may be temporary, reassures that saved data is safe, and gives next steps (retry, go to Finished goods, quote the reference). Thai wraps at word boundaries ('โปรดแจ้ง / ผู้ดูแลองค์กร…') with no clipped tone marks or vowels. Thai dates use the Buddhist year ('6 พ.ย. 2569 15:55') and English uses 'Nov 6, 2026, 3:56 PM'. Mobile actions are 48 px tall with no overflow, and the desktop content keeps a readable max-w-2xl column. The copied state (check icon plus 'คัดลอกแล้ว') and the retrying state (spinner plus 'Trying again…' at unchanged width) are both visible. The pending button uses disabled-surface styling, which matches the shared Button pending look, so I did not file it. The breadcrumb's current crumb is exposed as link [disabled]. That comes from the shared shadcn BreadcrumbPage, so I did not attribute it to this screen. The off-centre retry label shows in every capture of this screen and is specific to PageFailure. The locale-level error.tsx reuses the same PageFailure, so it would show the same skew, but that screen was not in this group.
